verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Trilegal serves an llms.txt at its root (HTTP 200) that describes the firm. The file directs agents to use index pages to discover detailed subpages dynamically, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's depth or coverage of practice pages, additional agent-oriented docs (e.g., llms-full.txt or markdown page versions), independent corroboration of agent usability.
